name: astra-db
description: Astra DB (DataStax / IBM) for coding agents: live database tools with interactive views, guarded writes and schema changes, vector and hybrid search, data-modeling and review skills, and 1,600+ idiomatic Data API snippets for Python, TypeScript, Java, C#, and Go.

token.title: Astra application token
token.description: Optional: an AstraCS: token, stored in your keychain. Leave empty to use the project's .env (npx -y @erichare/astra-mcp login) or your Astra CLI profile.

endpoint.title: Data API endpoint
endpoint.description: Optional default database endpoint (https://…apps.astra.datastax.com). A project .env overrides it; tokens that see one database need none.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Hide write and schema tools (insert, update, delete, create, drop).
